extraction: Computed by scripts/coverage_a370.py from the BUFFALO DR1 files in this directory.
note: DERIVED, not downloaded. Descriptive angular and physical radial coverage of each acquired Abell 370 catalogue about the adopted cluster centre (RA 39.9712, Dec -1.5767), converted with FlatLambdaCDM H0=70 Om0=0.3 at z_l=0.375 purely for units. Reports percentiles only; no fit, no model, no held-out data touched. Headline: the A370 observables form a continuous radial ladder from 12 kpc (innermost strong-lensing image) to 6.2 Mpc (outermost Subaru weak-lensing source).
